verdict.rationale: Opting out of usage tracking is a fair question for an agency that runs public websites and online portals (eServices, EAMS), so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, cookies, or any tracking opt-out control. The pack covers only tax, filing and benefits guidance, plus probes showing a login wall on the transactional portal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
